zh.place: 半月酒吧 收银台 应急灯下

zh: 晚上11点55分。还没来电，收银台上只亮着一盏应急灯。
录音放完以后，谁都没再提那句“说好了”。
Theo一个人站在临街的窗边，背对着所有人。
去地下室的楼梯上，坐着Mason和Ethan。
Ethan在上面一级，Mason在下面一级。中间空着一个台阶。
十分钟前，Mason当着所有人喊了“我喜欢你”。之后两人就这么坐着，谁都没走。
你今晚就喝了一杯可乐。
沙发上，Wren一口花生差点喷出来。
我是腿疼，走不动。不是不想走。
嗯。你刚才冲到门口的时候挺快的。
Ethan瞪了他一眼。可屁股一动没动。
你俩打算在楼梯上坐到天亮？
Rowan举起双手，退回了吧台边。
Nico走到收银台后面。没电，收银机打不开，只能手算。
他从抽屉里拿出今晚的账单，一张一张摊开。
Theo、Wren、Mason、Ethan的，加上Rowan电话里让记的那张。
第六张写着“吧台——Nico请客”，是今晚Nico请大家喝的那几轮。
上面盖着“已付清”，签名只有一个字母：T。
背面夹着一张对折的小纸条。

zh.hint: 纸条就在手边。签名是T——全场名字里带T的，只有一个人。

opts.t: 直接打开
then: Nico的手指刚碰到折痕，又停住了。
万一里面写的是“不用找了”呢？

opts.t: 先抬头，往窗边看一眼
then: Theo还背对着这边，额头抵着玻璃。
他看不见这边。Nico松了口气，又有点失落。

opts.t: ……又抢单。说好了今晚我请的。
then: Nico小声嘟囔完，自己先愣了一下。
五年了，Theo一次都没让他请成过。

zh: Nico深吸一口气，把纸条打开了。
是Theo的字。歪歪扭扭，跟大学剧本上的批注一模一样。
“给N：五年了，每次都是你请。这次换我。生日快乐。——T”
Nico盯着最后四个字，愣住了。
手机在吧台上震了一下。

zh.title: 零点
zh.txt: 手机弹出提醒：今天是你的生日。

zh: 是手机自带的提醒。Nico自己都忘了。
他从来不过生日，也从来不跟任何人说。
只有大二那年，在话剧社的报名表上写过一次。
全世界都忘了，连他自己都忘了。只有Theo记得。

zh.hint: 零点了，Nico生日的第一分钟。唯一记得的那个人，就站在十米外的窗边。

opts.t: 他怎么会记得……五年了，他一次都没提过。
then: Nico忽然想起来：每年的今天，Theo好像都在店里。
每年都抢着买单。Nico一直以为，他就是爱抢单。

opts.t: 把手机扣在吧台上，假装没看见
then: 手机扣下去了，可那四个字还在眼前晃。
Nico拿笔算账，同一个数算错了两遍。

opts.t: ……神经病。

zh: 可下一秒，Nico的心又沉了下去。
“五年了，每次都是你请。这次换我。”
人要走了，把账算干净，从此谁也不欠谁。
他自己说的：纽约签他五年，他不回来了。
Rowan端着一杯热水走过来，靠在收银台边上。
Rowan扫了一眼账单，又扫了一眼纸条。他一点都不意外。
这张纸条，他写废了七张。

zh.hint: Rowan是Theo的室友。他知道些什么。Nico想问，又不敢问。

opts.t: 他要走了，这是跟我两清，对吧？
then: Rowan看着他，像在看一个傻子。

opts.t: 写废了七张？就这么几个字？
then: 每写一张，他都问我：会不会太明显。
我说你写个生日快乐，能明显到哪儿去。

opts.t: 不说话，把纸条攥进手心
then: Rowan看着Nico攥紧的手，叹了口气。

zh: Rowan往窗边看了一眼，确定Theo听不见。
他根本没签那份五年合同。

zh.title: 合同还没签
zh.txt: 纽约那份五年合同，Theo到现在一个字都没签。

zh: 合同在他包里揣了一个月了。
他跟我说，他在等一个人开口留他。
Nico手里的笔“啪”地掉在了地上。

zh.hint: 一个月了，合同一直没签。他在等的那个人，会是谁？

opts.t: 那他为什么当着所有人说不回来了？
你别乱说。他等的人不一定是我。
then: Rowan喝了口热水，嘴角动了一下。

opts.t: 转头看向窗边的Theo
then: Theo攥着手机，屏幕上是明早的航班信息。
他的背影在雨里，看着特别单薄。

zh: 我答应过他不说的。可我是护士，见不得人硬撑。
他上飞机之前得给纽约答复。七点十分。你自己算。
Rowan拍了拍收银台，端着热水走回了窗边。
Wren早就盯着这边了。她抱着花生，一点一点挪了过来。
你俩嘀咕什么呢？Rowan一走，你脸白得跟鬼一样。
哦，这灯照谁都像鬼。但你是特别像。

zh.hint: Wren是唯一知道Nico喜欢Theo的人。要告诉她吗？

opts.t: 一句话不说，把纸条推到她面前
then: Wren低头一看，手里的花生掉了一颗。

opts.t: 没事，账对不上。
then: Nico没吭声。Wren直接把纸条从他手底下抽了出来。

opts.t: ……你知道今天是我生日吗？
then: 我认识你九年，我都不知道！

zh: Wren捏着纸条，又念了一遍。声音越念越小。
我认识你九年，都不知道你哪天生日。
抢什么，我又不跟你抢人。
Nico把Rowan的话，一字一句告诉了她。
Wren听完，“啪”地把花生拍在吧台上。
那你还站在这儿算什么账！

zh.hint: Wren在逼他。五年没说出口的话，现在一句就够了。可Nico怕。

opts.t: 万一我开了口，他留下了，以后后悔怎么办？
then: 你替他做了五年决定了，够了。

opts.t: 万一他等的根本不是我呢？
then: 这屋里谁的名字是N开头的？

opts.t: 不说话，用拇指一遍一遍蹭那个T
then: 那个T被他蹭得有点糊了。
Wren没再说话，轻轻按了一下他的肩膀。
还有，你在地下室又拿玩笑糊弄过去了吧？
今晚不许再开玩笑了。至少这件事不行。
你刚才都当着他的面说“有喜欢的人”了。
就差一个名字。五年都走到这儿了，差这一步？
else: 你今晚已经比过去五年都勇敢了。

zh: 楼梯那边，Ethan往下挪了一点。就一点。
看见没？人家都挪了半个台阶了。你呢？

then: 他的目光越过蜡烛，直直落在Nico身上。
他没笑，也没躲。像在等Nico把地下室那句话说完。
航班正常。托你的福，我肯定走得成。
他笑着说的。可眼睛一点都没笑。
else: 老板，算完没？算不清就记我账上。
说完他自己先愣了一下，又低头去看手机。

zh: Nico把账单和纸条并排摆在应急灯下。

zh.prompt: Extreme close-up on a wooden bar counter at night, lit only by a harsh green-white emergency light. A handwritten bar tab stamped PAID lies beside a small unfolded paper note with messy handwriting, both blurred and unreadable. An adult man's fingers rest at the edge of the note, a phone face down nearby. Candle glow out of focus in the background, rain streaks on a dark window. Cinematic, moody, shallow depth of field, no legible text.
skip: Nico把手按在纸条上，没再看。

zh.hint: 凌晨12点04分。合同没签，航班七点十分。Theo就在那儿。

opts.t: 五年了。我每年都想说，每年都没说。
then: 虽然只是写在一张账单背面。

opts.t: 把纸条按原来的折痕折好
then: 纸条折回去了，跟刚才一模一样。
可Nico知道，有些东西折不回去了。

opts.t: 他在等人留他。……我凭什么留他？
then: Nico想起那张纽约的合同，想起那个他等了好多年的主角。
然后又想起那四个字：生日快乐。

zh: Nico捏着那张第六张账单，手心全是汗。
这张账单，你打算怎么办？

en.place: The Halfmoon — the register, under the emergency light

en: 11:55 PM. Still no power. One emergency light glows over the register.
Since the recording ended, nobody has mentioned "it's a deal."
Theo is alone at the front window, his back to the room.
Mason and Ethan are sitting on the basement stairs.
Ethan one step up, Mason one step down. One empty stair between them.
Ten minutes ago Mason yelled "I like you" in front of everybody. They've sat like this ever since. Neither one has left.
Mason is quiet for two full seconds.
On the couch, Wren nearly chokes on a peanut.
My knee hurts, that's all. I'm not staying because I want to.
Uh-huh. You made it to the door pretty fast a minute ago.
Ethan glares at him. But he doesn't move an inch.
You two planning to sit on those stairs till sunrise?
Rowan raises both hands and backs off to the bar.
Nico heads behind the register. No power, the till won't open. He'll have to do it by hand.
He takes tonight's tabs out of the drawer and lays them out one by one.
Theo's. Wren's. Mason's. Ethan's. The one Rowan called in.
The sixth reads "Bar — on Nico." Every round Nico bought tonight.
It's stamped PAID. Signed with a single letter: T.
A small folded note is tucked behind it.

en.hint: The note's right there. Signed T — and only one person here has a T in his name.

opts.t: Just open it
then: His finger touches the crease and stops.
What if it just says "keep the change"?

opts.t: Look over at the window first
then: Theo still has his back to the room, forehead against the glass.
He can't see over here. Nico is relieved. And a little disappointed.

opts.t: ...He grabbed the check again. Tonight was supposed to be on me.
then: Five years, and Theo has never once let him pay.

en: Nico takes a breath and unfolds it.
Theo's handwriting. Messy, exactly like his notes in their old college scripts.
"N — Five years, and it's always on you. This one's on me. Happy birthday. —T"
Nico stares at the last two words.
His phone buzzes on the counter.

en.title: Midnight
en.txt: Phone reminder: Today is your birthday.

en: A default phone reminder. Nico had completely forgotten.
He never celebrates. He never tells anyone.
He wrote it down exactly once: on the theater club sign-up sheet, sophomore year.
Theo was the one who collected the sheets.
The whole world forgot. Even he forgot. Only Theo remembered.

en.hint: Midnight. The first minute of Nico's birthday. The one person who remembered is standing by the window, thirty feet away.

opts.t: How does he remember... Five years, and he's never said a word.
then: It hits Nico: every year on this date, Theo was here.
Every year he grabbed the check. Nico always thought he just liked grabbing checks.

opts.t: Put the phone face down and pretend you didn't see
then: The phone's face down. The words are still right there.
He tries to add up a tab and gets the same number wrong twice.

opts.t: ...Idiot.
then: And then his eyes start to sting.

en: Then, a second later, his heart drops.
"Five years, always on you. This one's on me."
He's leaving, so he squares the account. Nobody owes anybody anything.
He said it himself. New York signed him for five years. He's not coming back.
Rowan wanders over with a cup of hot water and leans on the register.
He glances at the tab, then the note. He isn't surprised at all.
He threw out seven drafts of that note.

en.hint: Rowan is Theo's roommate. He knows something. Nico wants to ask, and doesn't dare.

opts.t: He's leaving. This is him settling up with me, right?
then: Rowan looks at him like he's an idiot.

opts.t: Seven drafts? For a few words?
then: Every single one, he asked me: is this too obvious?
I said, how obvious can "happy birthday" be?

opts.t: Say nothing. Close your hand around the note
then: Rowan looks at Nico's clenched fist and sighs.

en: Rowan glances at the window to make sure Theo can't hear.
He never signed the five-year contract.

en.title: It's Not Signed
en.txt: Theo still hasn't signed a single page of the New York contract.

en: It's been sitting in his bag for a month.
He told me he's waiting for someone to ask him to stay.
Nico's pen clatters to the floor.
Waiting. For someone. To ask him to stay.

en.hint: A month, and he still hasn't signed. Who is he waiting for?

opts.t: Then why did he tell everyone he's not coming back?
then: Because he wanted to see who'd panic.
He watched all night. Only you.

opts.t: Don't. He's not necessarily waiting for me.
then: Did I say it was you?
Rowan sips his water. The corner of his mouth twitches.

opts.t: Turn and look at Theo by the window
then: Theo is gripping his phone. Tomorrow's flight is on the screen.
Against the rain, his back looks so thin.

en: I promised him I wouldn't tell. But I'm a nurse. I can't stand watching people tough it out.
He has to give New York an answer before he boards. Seven-ten. Do the math.
Rowan taps the counter and carries his water back to the window.
Wren's been watching the whole time. She inches over, hugging her peanuts.
What were you two whispering about? You're white as a ghost.
Okay, this light makes everyone look like a ghost. But you're winning.

en.hint: Wren is the only one who knows how Nico feels about Theo. Tell her?

opts.t: Say nothing. Slide the note over to her
then: She looks down. A peanut falls out of her hand.

opts.t: Nothing. The numbers don't add up.
then: Nico doesn't answer. Wren slides the note right out from under his hand.

opts.t: ...Did you know today's my birthday?
then: I've known you nine years and I didn't know!

en: Wren reads the note again. Her voice gets quieter and quieter.
Nine years. I never knew your birthday.
Nico, this isn't a tab. It's a love letter.
Relax. I'm not stealing your man.
Nico tells her what Rowan said, word for word.
Wren slaps the bag of peanuts down on the bar.
He didn't sign? He's waiting for someone to ask him to stay?
Then what are you doing back here doing math?!

en.hint: Wren is pushing. Five years of not saying it — now it would take one sentence. But Nico is scared.

opts.t: What if I ask, he stays, and then he regrets it?
then: You've been deciding for him for five years. Enough.

opts.t: What if I'm not who he's waiting for?
then: Whose name in this room starts with N?

opts.t: Say nothing. Rub your thumb over the T, again and again
then: The T starts to smudge under his thumb.
Wren doesn't say anything. She just squeezes his shoulder.
Also — you joked your way out of it in the basement again, didn't you?
No more jokes tonight. Not about this.
You already told him, to his face, that there's someone you like.
All that's missing is a name. Five years, and you stop one step short?
else: You've been braver tonight than in the last five years.

en: Over on the stairs, Ethan scoots down a little. Just a little.
I'm still half a step away.
See that? They closed half a step. What about you?
At the window, Theo finally turns around.

then: His eyes go past the candles, straight to Nico.
He doesn't smile. Doesn't look away. Like he's waiting for Nico to finish what he started in the basement.
Flight's on time. Thanks to you, I'm definitely making it.
He's smiling when he says it. His eyes aren't.
else: Hey, boss, done yet? If it doesn't add up, put it on my tab.
He hears himself, freezes for a second, and looks back down at his phone.

en: Nico lays the tab and the note side by side under the emergency light.

en.prompt: Extreme close-up on a wooden bar counter at night, lit only by a harsh green-white emergency light. A handwritten bar tab stamped PAID lies beside a small unfolded paper note with messy handwriting, both blurred and unreadable. An adult man's fingers rest at the edge of the note, a phone face down nearby. Candle glow out of focus in the background, rain streaks on a dark window. Cinematic, moody, shallow depth of field, no legible text.
then: One little slip of paper. Five years on it.
skip: Nico presses his palm flat over the note and doesn't look again.

en.hint: 12:04 AM. The contract isn't signed. The flight is at 7:10. Theo is right there.

opts.t: Five years. Every year I meant to say it. Every year I didn't.
then: This year, he said it first.
Even if it's only on the back of a bar tab.

opts.t: Fold the note back along its old crease
then: The note folds back exactly the way it was.
But Nico knows some things don't fold back.

opts.t: He's waiting for someone to ask him to stay. ...Who am I to ask?
then: Nico thinks of the New York contract. The lead role Theo waited years for.
Then he thinks of those two words. Happy birthday.

en: Nico grips the sixth tab. His palm is soaked.
What do you do with the tab?

zh: Nico从收银台后面走了出来，手里攥着那张账单。
他穿过整个酒吧。所有人都看见了，没人出声。
Nico在窗边站定，把账单举到Theo面前。
Theo看了一眼，笑了。笑得有点慌。

zh.hint: 账单就在两人中间。Nico想问的太多了。

opts.t: 你怎么知道我生日？我谁都没说过。
then: 大二，话剧社报名表。你写的，我收的。
就看了一眼。然后就忘不掉了。

opts.t: 哪有客人给老板买单的？钱我转你。
then: 你敢转，我就在纽约天天给你打差评。
他笑着说，笑完声音就低了下去。

opts.t: 为什么是今年？
then: 以后就没人替你记着了。

zh: 每年今天我都来。每年都想跟你说一句生日快乐。
可你每次都在给别人倒酒，忙得跟陀螺似的。
我只好抢着买单。好歹……算我请你一次。
Nico张了张嘴，什么都没说出来。
两人离得很近，近到能听见对方的呼吸。

then: 你在地下室说的那句话，我想了一晚上。
else: 其实今晚我一直在等。等你问我点什么。

zh: 地下室突然“哗啦”一声巨响。
水又上来了！漫过第五级台阶了！
Theo的话卡在了嘴边。他看着Nico，没说完。
en: Nico walks out from behind the register, the tab in his fist.
He crosses the whole bar. Everyone sees. Nobody makes a sound.
Wren clamps a hand over Ethan's mouth.
Nico stops at the window and holds the tab up in front of Theo.
Theo looks at it and laughs. A little panicked.

en.hint: The tab hangs between them. Nico has too many questions.

opts.t: How do you know my birthday? I never told anyone.
then: Sophomore year. Theater club sign-up sheet. You wrote it. I collected it.

opts.t: Customers don't buy the owner drinks. I'm paying you back.
then: Try it and I'll leave you a one-star review from New York every day.
He laughs. Then his voice drops.

opts.t: Why this year?
then: Because if I didn't say it this year...
...there'd be nobody left to remember it for you.

en: I come in every year on this day. Every year I want to say happy birthday.
But you're always pouring for everyone else, spinning like a top.
So I grab the check. That way... at least one round's on me.
Nico opens his mouth. Nothing comes out.
They're close. Close enough to hear each other breathe.

then: What you said in the basement — I've been thinking about it all night.
else: Honestly, I've been waiting all night. For you to ask me something.

en: A huge crash from the basement.
The water's back! It's past the fifth step!
Theo's words catch in his throat. He looks at Nico. He doesn't finish.

zh: Nico把纸条按原来的折痕折好，夹回账单背面。
然后把整张账单对折，揣进了围裙口袋。
就当没看见。就当今天只是个普通的周六。
Theo看见了那个动作。Nico知道他看见了。

zh.hint: 被Theo看见了。Nico总得有点反应。

opts.t: 冲他笑一下，若无其事
then: Theo也笑了一下。笑得很勉强。

opts.t: 移开眼睛，拿抹布擦吧台
then: 吧台已经很干净了。Nico还是擦了三遍。

opts.t: 还喝吗？最后一杯。
then: 他说“明天”的时候，眼睛看着Nico的口袋。

zh: Theo什么都没说。他转回窗边。
他收起来了。那就是他的答案。
他只看见Theo低下头，肩膀塌了一点。
Theo看了一眼屏幕，整个人僵住了。
是一条航班通知：“您的航班状态已变更。”
Theo把手机扣在窗台上。什么都没说。
就像Nico口袋里那张账单一样。
en: Nico folds the note along its crease and tucks it behind the tab.
Then he folds the whole tab in half and slips it into his apron pocket.
Never saw it. Today's just a normal Saturday.
He looks up. Theo is watching him.
Theo saw. Nico knows he saw.

en.hint: Theo saw. Nico has to do something.

opts.t: Smile at him like nothing happened
then: Theo smiles back. It doesn't quite work.

opts.t: Look away and wipe down the bar
then: The bar is already clean. Nico wipes it three more times.

opts.t: Want another? Last one.
then: Nah. I've got a flight to catch.
When he says "flight," he's looking at Nico's pocket.

en: Theo doesn't say anything. He turns back to the window.
He put it away. That's his answer.
He only sees Theo's head drop, his shoulders sag a little.
A second later, Theo's phone lights up.
Theo glances at the screen and goes completely still.
A flight alert: "Your flight status has changed."
Theo sets the phone face down on the windowsill. He doesn't say a word.
Just like the tab in Nico's pocket.

zh: Nico拿起一只空杯子，用勺子敲了三下。
所有人都转过头来，连楼梯上那两个都抬起了头。
Nico清了清嗓子，把纸条念了出来。
“给N：五年了，每次都是你请。这次换我。生日快乐。——T”
Mason已经冲进储物间翻东西了。一分钟后，他端出一片柠檬，上面插着一根蜡烛。
零点零六分，正式生效。生日快乐，老板。
Ethan起头唱生日歌，跑调跑到了外婆家。大家笑成一团。

zh.hint: 所有人围着Nico。柠檬上的蜡烛在晃。

opts.t: 许个愿……希望今晚别再进水了。
闭上眼，许一个不能说出口的愿
吹蜡烛之前，先在人群里找Theo

zh: 蜡烛吹灭了，大家欢呼。可Nico发现，少了一个人。
让他待会儿吧。那张纸条，他写了一个星期。
en: Nico picks up an empty glass and taps it three times with a spoon.
Everyone turns. Even the two on the stairs look up.
Nico clears his throat and reads the note out loud.
"N — Five years, and it's always on you. This one's on me. Happy birthday. —T"
Dude, why didn't you SAY so?!
Mason is already digging through the storeroom. A minute later he comes back with a lemon slice and a candle stuck in it.
Twelve-oh-six. Officially official. Happy birthday, boss.
Ethan starts the birthday song, wildly off-key. Everyone cracks up.

en.hint: Everyone's crowded around Nico. The candle on the lemon flickers.

opts.t: Here's my wish... no more flooding tonight.
Close your eyes and make a wish you can't say out loud
then: Wren watches him and lets out a quiet sigh.

opts.t: Before blowing it out, look for Theo in the crowd
then: Nico looks around the whole room. He isn't there.

en: The candle goes out. Everyone cheers. But Nico realizes someone's missing.
The kitchen door is still swinging.
He went in there the second you finished reading.
Give him a minute. He spent a week on that note.
Nico stares at the door. He doesn't move.
...Uh, guys? The kitchen floor drain is spitting up water.
